name: Granola
siboNotes: Very small portions may be tolerated, but most commercial granolas contain high-FODMAP ingredients. SIBO patients should avoid or use sparingly as a garnish.
preparationTips: Make homemade granola with oats, maple syrup, and low-FODMAP nuts/seeds
Check labels for high-FODMAP ingredients like honey, dried fruit, inulin, or chicory root
Use as a small garnish rather than a main cereal portion
Look for simple granolas with minimal ingredients
alternatives: Rice crisps or puffed rice cereal
Low-FODMAP muesli made with oats and allowed nuts
nutritionalHighlights: Healthy fats from nuts and seeds
